newsitem.title: USA: Gingrich sees progress toward balanced budget.
newsitem.headline: Gingrich sees progress toward balanced budget.

text.p: Republican House Speaker Newt Gingrich said Thursday he was hopeful of making progress with the Clinton administration towards a balanced budget.

"I think we're going to have a very productive year. I noted the president's comments yesterday and I believe we're going to have a lot of things to work on together. I think we will make progress toward a balanced budget," Gingrich told reporters as he returned to Washington from his home near Atlanta.
Clinton said Wednesday he wanted Congress to stop focusing on ethics scandals and work on more important issues.
